Senior Product Designer, Growth
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.
About Superhuman
Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites.

The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically.

Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com .

s.h: Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here .
s.t:
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Growth team, where you will shape the end-to-end experience that brings new users into the Superhuman ecosystem and drives meaningful activation, retention, and expansion. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to design experiences that are both delightful and measurably effective.

Own the design of key growth surfaces including onboarding, activation flows, referral programs, and upgrade moments across Superhuman’s product suite
Design the full journey, not isolated touchpoints — connecting key user moments into a coherent end-to-end experience instead of optimizing screens in isolation
Translate quantitative and qualitative insights into clear, compelling design solutions that move growth metrics
Drive experimentation — define hypotheses, design A/B tests, and iterate rapidly based on results
Collaborate cross-functionally with Growth PM, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to align on strategy and ship high-quality work
Contribute to and evolve Superhuman’s design system, ensuring consistency and quality at scale
Bring a sharp eye for craft, including typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You will help elevate the quality bar of everything the team ships.

5+ years of product design experience, with at least 2 years focused on growth, conversion, or lifecycle design
A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design work with measurable business impact
Deep experience with experimentation and data-informed design decision-making
Proficiency in Figma and a working knowledge of prototyping tools
Excellent communication and storytelling skills — you can articulate design rationale to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Experience working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with high ambiguity
Support for you, professionally and personally
Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.
A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways.

This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.
Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.
Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.
We encourage you to apply
At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About BeInCrypto
BeInCrypto is a part of the media group BeInNews Ltd, a global newsroom and research team covering institutional finance and digital assets as they intersect: regulation, trading infrastructure, and market structure - backed by original data and a team reporting from every major time zone.

Our 100+ journalists and analysts operate across 50+ countries, publishing in 26 languages. We are official media partners at Money20/20, Digital Assets Forum London, Korea Blockchain Week, Token2049, Proof of Talk, and other leading industry events.

We’re searching for a Senior Graphic Designer to redefine how the world’s leading crypto media brand looks and feels as we evolve into an institutional-grade financial intelligence platform. This is a role for someone who loves creating visually striking concepts as much as crafting polished digital experiences.

Around 60% of your time will be dedicated to graphic and visual design (editorial covers, campaigns, presentations, branding, and key visuals), while 40% will focus on web and UI design, shaping landing pages, website sections, and digital interfaces.

You’ll have the freedom to bring bold ideas to life, influence our visual direction, and build work seen by millions of users and the industry’s biggest players.
Tasks
Lead the evolution of BeInCrypto’s visual identity across digital products, editorial, marketing, and sales materials.
Create concept-driven editorial covers, social media covers, one-pagers, banners, reports, infographics, presentations, and key creative assets that communicate complex ideas through compelling visual storytelling.
Design website pages, landing pages, UI components, and web sections in collaboration with the Lead UX Designer.
Develop and present creative concepts for campaigns, product launches, and special projects from idea to final execution.
Ensure visual consistency and high-quality brand application across all company touchpoints.
Use AI-powered design tools to accelerate creative workflows and explore new visual approaches.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve design quality, workflows, and brand impact.

Have at least 3 years of experience in graphic and digital design for web-first or/and media companies.
Have strong experience designing both high-end visual branding and web/UI projects, including landing pages, websites, responsive layouts, and interface components.
Are highly proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, and AI-powered design tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, or similar.
Have exceptional skills in typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy, and concept development.
Can independently transform complex ideas into visually engaging and effective designs.
Have a portfolio showcasing both strong graphic design (branding, editorial, campaigns, presentations, reports, key visuals) and implemented web/UI projects.
Communicate confidently with cross-functional teams and present design decisions clearly.
Are fluent in English.

Experience working with well-known consumer or technology brands.
Formal education in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
Experience with crypto, fintech, finance, or media products.

100% remote work, work from wherever you’re most creative.
Flexible working hours with no time trackers.
Creative ownership and the freedom to shape the visual direction of a globally recognized media brand.
The opportunity to build a portfolio featuring high-impact editorial, branding, marketing, and web design projects.
Access to modern AI-powered design tools and the freedom to experiment with new creative workflows.
Collaboration with experienced designers, product, marketing, and editorial teams on ambitious cross-functional projects.
Clear goals, trust, and autonomy in how you achieve them.
Paid time off to recharge.
Internal learning programs and masterclasses.
Support for personal branding and industry visibility.
An inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, nationality, gender, identity, abilities, or beliefs, can thrive.

You’ll be working with the Creative team. Your manager will be the Chief Executive Officer. This team shapes our brand’s identity and drives its visibility. They craft stunning visuals, like website layouts, article covers, and graphics, and build our presence through social media and content marketing. Every beautiful image and impactful message you see is their creative masterpiece.
Ready to start your new journey with us?
At BIC, we value your ideas, curiosity, dynamism, adaptability, ownership mindset, passion for innovation and AI, awareness of industry trends, and ability to work autonomously and stay organized. If this approach resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team and achieve new heights together!
Please attach your portfolio to your CV when applying; it’s the first step of our hiring process. We will automatically reject all applications without a portfolio. We’re looking for a portfolio that showcases both strong graphic/visual design (branding, editorial, campaigns, presentations, key visuals, etc.) and real web/UI projects (landing pages, websites, interface components, responsive design).
Recruitment process: Portfolio review → HR interview → Design test → Interview with Senior Communication Designer → Final interview with the CEO.
Apply now, and our Recruitment team will contact you with the next steps.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
As a Senior Product Designer at DeepL, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the translation experience at the heart of DeepL Translate, the AI-first translation platform millions of people reach for every day to localize their content. You'll join a cross-functional team that is central to delivering a fast, trustworthy, and scalable product, collaborating closely with product managers and engineering leaders to define and drive the product vision.
Beyond your immediate team, you will actively contribute to DeepL's broader design community—helping evolve our craft, influence best practices, and raise the bar for design across the company.
This is a high-impact role for a designer who is comfortable navigating complexity, cares deeply about user experience, and thrives in collaborative, strategic environments.

You will be responsible for solving a critical problem: making translation feel effortless and trustworthy for anyone who needs to communicate across languages — whether they're translating a sentence, a document, or their daily work. We expect you to:
Become an expert on who our users are and what each user group needs, from casual translators to professionals who rely on DeepL every day
Conduct generative and evaluative user research to define problems and validate solutions
Gather and evaluate requirements with cross-functional team members
Communicate design concepts early and often, backed by qualitative insights and quantitative data
Deliver vibe coded prototypes, final design specifications in Figma and make small code changes in production
Share the responsibility to maintain and expand the design system
Qualities we look for
You have 4+ years of experience in product teams providing design solutions for web applications
You have a strong understanding of user-centered design processes
You have experience designing for B2B audiences but have a great eye for design. Experience in B2C design is a bonus point
You can drive design throughout the whole lifecycle of an idea — discovering problems, defining success, evaluating solutions, and measuring impact
You understand the power of storytelling and are comfortable in driving stakeholders buy-in
You can consistently use qualitative and quantitative insights to guide your design process
You are confident owning and co-owning design artefacts in Figma
You are as confident in using AI to support your work, especially to create design assets and prototypes, we mostly use Claude Code
You have experience working on a product at scale with a global presence
You have strong communication and presentation skills
You are fluent in English. Any other languages, e.g. German, are an advantage

Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!
We are an equal opportunity employer
You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

About Anaconda
Be at the center of AI
Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI.

With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Anaconda 's Design organization now owns our design system end to end, from Figma libraries and design tokens through to the code components engineers ship. We're mid-flight on a migration of our component architecture to a modern stack, converging two product surfaces into one platform, and defining how a design practice works in an agentic AI world.
As our Principal Product Designer, you'll own the design system as a product: its architecture, its governance, and its evolution across converging surfaces. You'll partner directly with engineering to land the migration, then build the AI-forward design practice on top of it: the patterns, tooling, and workflows for designing agentic product experiences. This is a senior IC role reporting to the VP of Design, operating with wide autonomy in a deliberately flat, senior team.

Own the design system end to end: design tokens, component libraries, documentation, and the code components engineers consume, across two converging product surfaces.
Lead the migration of our component architecture to a modern stack (shadcn/ui, Storybook), partnering with engineering to re-baseline scope and ship a complete, production-quality tranche.
Define the governance that outlives any individual: versioning, contribution model, release process, and explicit exit criteria for design handoff that both design and engineering sign.
Establish Anaconda 's AI-forward design practice: patterns, guidelines, and tooling for agentic product surfaces, and ship the first product experiences that use them.
Work in design and code: prototype in the production stack and review component implementations.
Raise the bar across a senior design team through influence: critique, pairing, and visible craft.
Use AI-assisted tools, including Claude Code, reviewing and validating AI generated output before it ships.

s.h: Your Impact Will Be Measured Through
s.t:
Completion and adoption of the component architecture migration across both product surfaces.
Reduction in design-to-engineering handoff time and rework, measured against explicit exit criteria.
Cross-team adoption of design system governance: versioned releases, contribution model, and shared definition of done.
AI-forward design patterns shipped in production surfaces and reused across the platform.

12+ years of product design experience, including several years owning a design system at scale, tokens, component architecture, and governance, not only consumption.
Engineering fluency: comfortable working in TypeScript/React component codebases and Storybook, and applied in technical architecture discussions.
Proven experience leading a design system migration or re-platform in a production environment, including scoping what ships and what parks.
Demonstrated experience designing AI-driven or agentic product experiences.
Experience using AI assisted tools, such as Claude Code, as part of a professional workflow, including reviewing and validating AI generated output before it ships.
A track record of leading through influence in flat or ambiguous structures, defining the operating model rather than executing within one.

s.h: What Will Make You Stand Out
s.t:
You've taken a design system through a framework migration at enterprise scale and can walk us through what you kept, cut, and parked — and why.
Contributions to open-source design systems or component libraries, with public work you can show.
Experience designing for developer tools, data science, or technical audiences.
You've built design tooling or automation — internal tools, Figma plugins, or AI-assisted design workflows — that other designers adopted.
Experience working across converging or multi-product platforms where the design system was the connective tissue.
A clear point of view on how AI is reshaping design practice, shaped by hands-on work designing agentic experiences.
You embody our values: "Curious by Default", "Build Together", "Own It", and "Lead with Guts and Heart", and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor.
You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish.

You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.
You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth.

Engaging with HelloFresh in Warsaw means collaborating with HelloTech —a global technology division of over 1,000 people powering an end-to-end food ecosystem. From digital personalization and forecasting to supply chain optimization and food waste reduction, technology drives every step of this direct-to-consumer model.

HelloTech operates in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, with each team holding full accountability for a specific domain. By collaborating with the Warsaw office, the service provider will leverage a modern tech stack and work with international teams to shape scalable, data-driven platforms that impact millions of global customers.

s.h: About the Role: What's in the Box
s.t:
HelloFresh Group is building the next generation of consumer experiences across its portfolio—from discovery and personalization to shopping and subscription management. The Consumer UX team is at the heart of this work, designing end-to-end experiences that are simple, delightful, and grounded in real customer needs.
Services are required for Senior UX Designers across two squad contexts: one embedded in Good Chop , the premium American meat and seafood subscription brand, and one in the central Consumer UX team working across the broader HelloFresh Group portfolio. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Prompts spec out what Claude does. Evals measure whether it did. The Product Prompt and Eval Design team does both for product design: the system prompt that greets a new user, the tool descriptions that decide whether Claude searches, the instructions that keep a slide deck from tipping into slop, and the evals that test all of it.

The point is to keep the model and the product aligned with what users expect, what the product strategy calls for, and what safety requires, on every surface and through every model launch.
This role is a foundational member of that work on the eval side: building the evals that check the prompts, the harness that runs them, and the tools that let designers do this work themselves. It sits on the Product Prompt and Eval Design team in Product Design, works day to day with the team's surface owners and the engineers in each product team, and pairs per surface with the prompt engineering team at model releases.

Write and revise the prompts behind Claude's tools, features, and behaviors on a product surface; test the surface, turn findings into prompt fixes, ship them, and confirm the prompt users get is the one intended
Build the graders that prove a prompt fix and rerun on the next model; turn designers' hand-run rubrics into automated evals, then read transcripts for what the eval missed
Build visual, low-code eval tools designers can use without an engineer: assemble a comparison set from real transcripts, turn a plain-English rubric into a grader, compare prompt variants across models side by side, and read results in the tool rather than a notebook
Watch designers use those tools and make them simpler
Support model releases: test each surface against the new model, write prompt fixes and migrations, and write prompts for features launching with it, so the surface owner's call has numbers behind it
Stand up and scale the eval harness: build the test environment that exercises our 50 to 100 tools with trustworthy settings, keep evals green across models, and call whether a regression is the harness or the model
Package what prompting can't fix for training, with the eval attached: graders for crisp behaviors, human-feedback questions and good/bad pairs for fuzzy ones like writing quality

Your mission We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.
You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.
English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.
Concretely, you will: Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
Run the experiment, and read it honestly . Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

We strive to provide tailored, more affordable financial services that make people's hard-earned money go further. Now in our 14th year, with close to 400 employees in offices across Europe and the UK, we’re crafting a brilliant, relevant product that makes a difference in people's lives and the well-being of their families.
We’ve come this far by building a talented, diverse workforce on a fair culture and our strong values. Having this strong team of employees, we can serve those who really need our product to make their lives better.
Join us as a Senior Product Designer and help shape how money moves across the globe 💸.
At TransferGo, Product Design is not simply a service that turns requirements into screens. Designers are part of the product trio, working alongside Product and Engineering to understand customer problems, shape strategy and deliver experiences that create meaningful customer and business outcomes.
In this role, you’ll lead complex initiatives from discovery through delivery across our web and mobile products. You’ll bring clarity to ambiguous problem spaces, connect customer needs with commercial and technical realities, and help teams make better product decisions.
You’ll also play an important role in raising the quality of design across TransferGo. Alongside owning your work, you’ll mentor other designers, contribute to our design practice and help us use emerging technologies, including AI to work more effectively without compromising judgement, responsibility or craft.
If you’re excited by complex fintech challenges, care deeply about the details and want to help a growing design team increase its impact, we’d love to meet you.

s.h: Here’s what you’ll do as a Senior Product Designer
s.t:
Lead significant product initiatives from problem framing and discovery through design, validation, delivery and post-launch iteration
Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineers to define the right problems, shape product direction and balance customer value, business goals and technical feasibility
Turn complex financial journeys and requirements into clear, accessible and trustworthy experiences across web and mobile
Use qualitative research, behavioural data, experimentation and product metrics to identify opportunities, evaluate trade-offs and measure the impact of your work
Plan and conduct appropriate research and validation, including user interviews, usability testing, concept testing and collaborative workshops
Develop and communicate a coherent design vision for your initiatives, connecting long-term direction with practical, iterative steps
Create high-quality user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, interfaces and specifications, including edge cases and non-ideal states
Collaborate with Engineering early and throughout delivery, considering feasibility and ensuring the implemented experience meets the intended quality
Contribute to and evolve our design system, creating reusable patterns and improving consistency between design and production
Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully throughout the design process; for example, to support research synthesis, problem framing, exploration, content design, rapid prototyping, data analysis and design reviews
Evaluate AI-generated work critically, protecting customer privacy and applying human judgement to accuracy, accessibility, quality and appropriateness
Communicate recommendations and design decisions clearly, using evidence and storytelling to build alignment and influence stakeholders
Mentor and support other designers through critique, feedback and practical guidance, helping raise the team’s overall quality and confidence
Improve the way we work by identifying opportunities to make design processes faster, clearer and more effective
You’ll report to our Head of Product Design.

We don’t expect you to meet every single requirement listed. What matters most is your motivation, mindset and ability to learn. If you’re excited about this role and think you could be a great fit, we’d really like to hear from you.
5+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products within cross-functional product teams

Strong product judgement and the ability to balance desirability, usability, viability, feasibility and delivery constraints
Advanced interaction and visual design skills, with close attention to detail, accessibility, consistency and usability
Strong systems thinking, including an understanding of how design decisions affect connected journeys, platforms, teams and future product development
Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and component-based workflows, with experience contributing to or evolving design systems
Confidence choosing and applying appropriate research and validation methods rather than relying on a single process for every problem
Experience using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions and evaluate outcomes

The ability to assess AI output critically, recognise its limitations and use it responsibly rather than treating it as a replacement for customer insight or professional judgement
Strong communication, facilitation and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain decisions and influence stakeholders across disciplines and levels
A proactive approach to collaboration with Product and Engineering, including involving partners early and navigating constraints constructively
The ability to organise design artefacts and documentation so that decisions, specifications and context are easy for others to understand
The confidence to challenge assumptions, give and receive constructive feedback, and change direction when evidence calls for it
The ability to balance speed and quality, make pragmatic trade-offs and move work forward without waiting for perfect information
A user-first, low-ego approach grounded in curiosity, empathy, accountability and a strong sense of ownership

This is a company built for growth.
When you join exmox, you’re stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone.
We build high-performing consumer products across multiple brands in one of the most competitive industries there is: mobile gaming. You will be part of a company on a path of hyper-growth, spearheading one of the largest innovations in the mobile gaming industry, rewarded user acquisition.
As a Senior Product Designer - UI Focus (f/m/x) at exmox, you'll join our product design team to shape the user interface and experience of our mobile-first B2C product, impacting millions of users. You'll own features from concept to handoff and create polished, engaging, habit-forming interfaces.

This role is about designing experiences that perform. You’ll work at the intersection of user behavior, data, and business goals, shaping flows that drive engagement and revenue. Your work reaches over 25 million users and feeds directly into experimentation and iteration, letting you see the real impact of your decisions.

At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
Our product design team is growing in maturity, and you’ll play a key role in shaping how design works at exmox. If you want high impact, real ownership, and a product at scale, we want to hear from you.

Feature ownership: Own and design new features from concept through final handoff.
UI design: Design visually engaging and highly polished interfaces for our B2C mobile app.
Visual assets: Create illustrations, icons, and other graphical assets to support your designs.
Developer handoff: Deliver production-ready assets, specifications, prototypes, and documentation to engineering teams.
Design system: Build, maintain, and contribute to our evolving design system.
Design quality: Conduct design reviews to ensure implementations match the intended designs.
Research collaboration: Work closely with UX research and data teams to evaluate and improve your designs.
Iteration & feedback: Gather feedback and continuously refine and improve your work.
What’s in it for you as a designer?
Impact: Your work directly influences a product used by millions. You’ll see the effect of your design decisions on business KPIs and learn how to create value through design.
Data-driven culture: Data sits at the core of every decision we make. You’ll design, test, and iterate based on real user insights and performance metrics.
Large global user base: You’ll design for a product with over 25 million users worldwide, operating at true scale.
Growing design maturity: Our product design team is on a journey to elevate design maturity at exmox, and you’ll actively shape and contribute to that evolution.
Cross-functional design team: You’ll collaborate within a dedicated design team including Product designers, UI Designers, and UX Researcher.

Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing outstanding mobile UI craft and visual design.
Professional experience: 5+ years of experience working in product teams as a UI, UI/UX, or Product Designer.
Consumer product design: Experience designing habit-forming, engaging, consumer-facing interfaces.
Industry background: Experience in marketing, gaming, or other B2C-heavy industries is a plus.

Design tools: Strong proficiency in Figma.
Motion & interaction design: Expertise in motion design, animation, and transitions to craft dynamic interfaces.
Visual asset creation: Expertise in creating illustrations, iconography, and other visual assets.
Design systems: Expertise in designing, shipping, and maintaining design systems.
Multi-brand products: Experience with multi-brand, white-label products and theming systems.
Brand identity: Experience in defining, designing, and documenting brand identities.
Copywriting: Experience in copywriting, including defining tone, voice, and messaging.
Accessibility & usability: Strong knowledge of accessibility and usability principles.
Frontend awareness: Understanding of front-end technologies and implementation constraints.
Language skills: Fluency in English; German is a plus.

Ownership: You take full responsibility for your work, drive initiatives forward, align stakeholders, and ensure meaningful value delivery.
Proactiveness: You anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and take initiative without waiting for direction.
Prioritisation: You focus on what matters most, balance speed and quality, and manage your workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Feedback mindset: You give constructive feedback thoughtfully and embrace feedback as an essential part of iteration and growth, comfortably navigating multiple refinement cycles.
Creative thinking: You explore a wide range of ideas and solutions from safe bets to bold, out-of-the-box concepts to achieve the most impactful outcome.
How We Win
Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.
Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Design Systems team creates the foundations that help teams across OpenAI build coherent, high-quality experiences at scale.
Accessibility is fundamental to that work. We’re building the shared standards, components, tools, and practices that make inclusive experiences the default across OpenAI’s products and platforms.

In this role, you’ll lead OpenAI’s company-wide accessibility program from within Design Foundations. You’ll pair strategy and organizational influence with hands-on product design—advocating for disabled people, removing barriers across complete customer journeys, and establishing durable ownership throughout the company.
This is an opportunity to define accessibility for a new generation of products spanning web, mobile, desktop, voice, AI, and hardware. You’ll help teams consider the many ways people perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with technology, going beyond minimum compliance to create experiences that are genuinely useful and inclusive.
Working across design, engineering, research, product, go-to-market, and legal, you’ll make accessibility an expected part of product quality—not a final review or the responsibility of a single expert.
This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Define OpenAI’s accessibility strategy, roadmap, governance, priorities, and measures of progress.
Design and ship accessible experiences while identifying systemic barriers across complete customer journeys.
Build accessibility into our design system through inclusive components, tokens, interaction patterns, Figma libraries, documentation, and engineering guardrails.
Center disabled people through participatory research, usability studies, and assistive-technology testing rather than relying solely on assumptions, simulations, or automated tools.
Design for permanent, temporary, and situational disabilities, including multiple ways to perceive information, navigate interfaces, understand content, and complete important tasks.
Establish practical standards for screen readers, keyboard navigation, focus, reading order, contrast, typography, motion, captions, forms, errors, and multimodal interactions.
Lead accessibility audits, remediation priorities, launch readiness, and continuous validation across platforms.
Partner with go-to-market, legal, compliance, and product teams on enterprise readiness, accessibility documentation, procurement needs, and customer commitments.
Grow company-wide capability through training, critiques, engineering partnerships, and a network of accessibility champions.

Pair deep accessibility expertise with strong interaction design, systems thinking, and a high bar for product craft.

Have deep practical knowledge of WCAG, assistive technologies, accessible interaction design, and platform-specific standards.
Have embedded accessibility into design systems, reusable components, and engineering workflows.
Have worked directly with disabled people and translated their experiences into meaningful product and organizational decisions.
Can identify assumptions and exclusion within a product journey, then turn those insights into clearer and more flexible ways to interact.
Are equally effective setting strategy, designing detailed experiences, and collaborating with engineers through implementation.
Can influence across disciplines without direct authority, creating shared accountability without becoming a centralized approval gate.

Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel.
Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
Für Design ist das ein seltener Ausgangspunkt: Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Für diese Berufe hat noch nie jemand ernsthaft gestaltet. Du wärst die erste Design-Person in unserem neuen Produktteam und baust Design-System und Designprozess mit auf.
Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben Wir arbeiten als ein Team von Product Engineers , manche technischer, manche gestalterischer. Du wärst die gestalterischste Person, arbeitest aber im selben Repository und Rhythmus wie alle anderen. Was du gestaltest, ist meist wenige Wochen später live.
Du verantwortest den Designprozess von Anfang bis Ende : Du führst Interviews mit Verwaltern und Eigentümern, verdichtest die Erkenntnisse zu Konzepten und gestaltest daraus Interfaces für Kundenportal und Verwaltercockpit. Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg.
Deine Designs bleiben nicht in Figma : Mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) bringst du sie selbst ins Frontend und setzt Teil-Features, teils auch ganze Features, gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Produkt landet, und legst dafür selbst Hand an.
Ein besonderes Feld ist Design für KI-Agenten : Du gestaltest Interaktionsmuster für Workflows, in denen Agenten Aufgaben übernehmen. Wo braucht der Nutzer Kontrolle, wo Transparenz? Muster, für die es noch kaum Vorbilder gibt.
Was du mitbringen solltest 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign, gern mit B2B-Software oder komplexen Workflows.
Ein Portfolio mit 2 bis 3 Case Studies, die deinen Weg von der Nutzerfrage bis zum ausgelieferten Interface zeigen: Deine Denkweise interessiert uns mehr als die Menge an Screens.
Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, von Wireframes über klickbare Prototypen bis zur Komponentenbibliothek.
Erfahrung mit qualitativem Research: Interviews führen, Erkenntnisse verdichten, Annahmen mit Usability-Tests prüfen.
Gespür für Interaction Design und Informationsarchitektur in datenreichen Anwendungen.
Gute bis sehr gute Praxis mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, v0): Du bringst Teil-Features oder ganze Features selbst in den Code.
Solide Grundlagen in HTML und CSS, JavaScript ist ein Plus.
Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.
Was wir dir bieten Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.
Echter Impact. Alles, was du gestaltest, kommt bei unseren Verwaltern, Eigentümern und Kunden direkt zum Einsatz.
Eine Branche von innen kennenlernen. Die Immobilienwirtschaft ist einer der größten Märkte Deutschlands und steht erst am Anfang ihrer Digitalisierung. Du lernst sie dort kennen, wo die Entscheidungen fallen.
Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Produktverantwortlichen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und jemand, der sich Zeit für deine Fragen nimmt.

s.h: About the role (What you'll be doing)
s.t:
You're a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.
Own a problem area across connected surfaces, not a queue of screens, from definition to delivery.
Research it, design it, write it, test it, measure it, iterate. You drive it without waiting for a spec.
Move commercial outcomes on your surface: activation, conversion through regulated intake, retention, adherence. You know which metric you are moving and why.
Create designs that build trust and hold up in a regulated market.
What good looks like
Scope — you own a problem area end to end.
Impact — you moved a meaningful metric and can show the before and after.
Influence — you raise the bar around you. You give sharp critique. You make junior designers better without being asked to.

You're a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.

Problem definition. You shape the problem, not just the pixels. Using research, data and the input of others, you break the ambiguity down and package it back up into something the team can build. The signal is evidence you helped define the right problem, not just made the screens.
Visual craft. Non-negotiable. Typography, spacing, colour, motion and micro-interactions, used with intent, not decoration. Weak craft is a no, whatever the strategy talk.
Accessibility. You design inclusively without being asked. You know why the standard exists, not just what it says, and it shows in judgement calls a checklist cannot make.
Systems thinking. You design across surfaces, from mobile to emerging platforms like AI-native interfaces, and contribute to the system others build on. Infrastructure compounds. Single screens do not.
Product and commercial sense. You shaped what got built. Metrics, research and commercial awareness sit next to the work. Craft in isolation moves nothing.
Communication. Clear, specific, opinionated. You say what you decided and why, and you are just as clear on what you chose not to do and why.
Working in the open. You share early and often, and you use critique to sharpen the work. You lift the quality of every review you join.
How you work with AI
LLMs are already embedded in your workflow.
You prototype in tools like Claude Code and Cursor to test ideas in real code, not just mock them up. Tighter build-measure-learn loops.
The signal is workflow, not tool count. Judgement spent where it counts.
The full stack
We expect you to work end to end, from problem definition and research to information architecture and UX writing.
Your own research and usability testing.
Validation and experimentation. You set up A/B tests and read them honestly.
UX writing. In a regulated market, this is craft and compliance at once.
Problem definition. Break it down. Package it back up.
Your portfolio
Show problem solving that moved a commercial lever, not just well-made screens. We want evidence of the outcome, the craft behind it, the care in the finish, how you contributed to the Design System, and where AI tightened your process. How you write it says as much as what you show. Concise and clear is a signal of how you communicate. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
Experience
Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of owning problems end to end and influencing direction at a team level.
Behaviours & attitude
Patient-first mindset. You put patient outcomes first. Every decision weighs commercial growth against clinical safety and care, and you don't let one erode the other. You understand real health journeys well enough to make them simple, accessible and worth trusting.
Collaborative creation. You work well across product, engineering and clinical, and you know a good idea can come from any of them. You listen to feedback and take it on, using it to make the work better.
Curiosity. You ask why before how. You stay curious about the patient, the problem and the tools you use to solve it, and you're comfortable being a beginner when something new is worth learning.
Why you should join Euc
Our teams are incredibly passionate — Our talent bar is high and our work ethic is strong. You'll get to stretch yourself everyday and work amongst people who care deeply about our patients. You'll be given autonomy to tackle interesting problems and receive regular feedback from a supportive team.
We move at incredible speed — You'll work with team mates who build in the open by sharing their work freely; this helps us learn and iterate quickly so we can deliver high quality outcomes faster than our competitors. You'll spend a lot of time outside of your comfort zone learning and iterating frequently, we wouldn't have it any other way.
We will invest in your career — You'll get access to an annual professional development budget, mentors and buddies to ensure that you have the support you need to level up. You can expect regular performance and pay reviews as your career grows.
We are all owners — You'll be given equity to ensure that you are able to benefit in the upside of your contribution in helping Euc grow. Your ideas will be valued regardless of your role, you will have ownership over the projects you work on which will feel both terrifying but extremely fulfilling.
We play as hard as we work — From our annual Eucalympics (Olympic themed hackathon), monthly health & fitness allowances, free weekly barista coffees, funded social clubs, quarterly rooftop parties and weekly catered fireside chats, we know how to let our hair down!
We'll have your back when you need us the most — You'll be able to lean on a range of leave offerings to support you when needed, this includes: personal health and professional development leave, a generous parental leave that offers 20 weeks paid leave for a primary carer, additional miscarriage leave (see more on Kin Fertility's #WeNeedMoreLeave campaign), as well as our Employee Assistance Programme.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries.

It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is looking for a Lead Product Designer to help us design and prototype compelling A.I. experiences that help curious people understand and engage with the world.
We are looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape how readers search for information and understand the world through New York Times products — someone with a passion for design, journalism, and technology, as well as experience delivering A.I.-enabled consumer experiences at scale.
The New A.I. Products and Platforms mission is a critical, company-wide initiative tasked with building the next generation of A.I.-powered products to accelerate The New York Times's essential subscription strategy.
The Times operates in a hybrid model, with those based in NYC working in-office two days per week. We plan to speak with all candidates about where they're based and how they work in a hybrid environment.
As a Lead Product Designer, you'll identify opportunities to use A.I. to address news and information needs through our products' search feature. You'll use your interaction design and coded prototyping skills to build functional prototypes that gain alignment and drive work forward.

You'll validate that these prototypes meet users' informational needs and align with our brand and journalistic standards. You'll collaborate with product managers, engineers, user researchers, and editorial partners to ship excellent and performant experiences to the world.
We value an environment of learning and collaboration. You'll play a leadership role to grow and support more junior design team members. You'll help promote a "make to think" design culture. You'll participate in regular design rituals to give and receive critique.

Create sketches, mockups, user journeys and other UX artifacts to rapidly explore a range of editorial and consumer scenarios and identify promising concepts.

Improve the people and process around you by shaping and participating in team and Product Design rituals.
Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Product Designer who will own how the Geotab Video Platform looks, feels, and works, driving design initiatives end-to-end for our AI dashcam and video intelligence software. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

As a Senior Product Designer, your key area of responsibility will be driving design initiatives across cross-functional teams to shape the product design vision, creating complex data-heavy surfaces (such as live video review, safety timelines, and fleet dashboards), and championing our design system.

You will need to work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Research, and senior leadership. To be successful in this role you will be a self-starter with strong communication skills, excellent UX judgment, and a high degree of autonomy who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

In addition, the successful candidate will have 5-8 years of product design experience with deep knowledge of Figma, responsive web application patterns, and a strong portfolio of shipped products.
How you’ll make an impact
Responsible for driving design initiatives in cross-functional teams, promoting cross-functional collaboration and ensuring the seamless integration of design solutions throughout the product development lifecycle.
Take a proactive role in identifying opportunities to enhance design capabilities and effectiveness, initiating improvements in design methodologies, tools, and workflows to optimize efficiency and deliver exceptional user experiences.
Conduct research, user testing, and analysis to gain deep insights into user behaviors, preferences, and pain points, guiding the development of user-centered design solutions.
Take responsibility for knowledge sharing within the design team, mentoring and supporting junior designers to foster their professional growth and excellence.
Advise manager on user-centric design principles and best practices, ensuring that design solutions align with user needs and industry standards.
Gather requirements and align design efforts with business objectives, actively seeking opportunities to improve the overall product experience.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and design best practices, continuously evolving design skills and knowledge.
Advise on design concepts and communicate ideas effectively to stakeholders, presenting design solutions and justifying design decisions based on user research and data.
Work independently with developers and product managers to ensure the successful implementation of design solutions, providing guidance and support throughout the development process.
Champion the adoption and evolution of a design system, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive its implementation and maintenance by establishing and encouraging the adoption of design system guidelines.
Lead efforts within a cross-functional team to advocate and contribute to our design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across products and platforms.
Mentor earlier stage designers across the design team; leveling up the team, helping to improve best practices, processes and tooling.
Help build a high-functioning design team and culture; contributing to hiring processes, providing thoughtful feedback in design critiques, identifying internal and external opportunities to level up design at Geotab.

s.h: What you’ll bring to this role
s.t:
5-8 years of relevant industry experience owning product design end-to-end for shipped software, ideally in B2B, SaaS, telematics, video, or another data-rich domain.
A portfolio of shipped products that reached real users, with clear evidence of the parts you personally owned.
Relevant Bachelor’s Diploma/Degree or equivalent industry experience (Degree specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or related field preferred).
Deep knowledge of product design, including UI design proficiency, modern design systems, prototyping, interaction patterns, responsive web applications, and expert command of tools like Figma.
Strong UX judgment grounded in research with the ability to lead all aspects of user-centered design, conduct usability testing, and analyze behavior data to drive decisions.
Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate complex ideas, defend design decisions with reasoning and data, and engage across all levels of the organization.
Self-starter and adaptable team player comfortable with high-intensity workloads, minimal supervision, and collaborating daily with product and engineering teams.
